text: Extend the landed fix 'Don't stop a batch on repeated failure of an item already paused' to items the scope guard has only flagged: after an item fails twice, pause it and go on to the next item instead of stopping the batch. At 11:13pm UTC on 3 Nov a batch stopped with money and slots left because item 20261103-193428-df2m was flagged (T1, T3, T5), not paused. Acceptance: a test where an item fails twice and is flagged, and the batch then runs the next item.
